text:
As you went against the protocol and applied after she arrived on a tourist visa with the intention to stay MH is not obligated and likely won't give her an entry visa.
Once you have started the process you can of course go to MH and request one.
Don't leave if she didn't receive the entry visa as she won't be able to enter Israel until you receive the invitation.
Note, depending on your MH she could be without a valid visa to work or leave for several months to a year.
Once you have applied make sure to keep extending her tourist visa.
Good luck 🙏
